mainEntity.name: How do I find off-market oceanfront condos in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finding off-market oceanfront condos primarily requires strong networking with experienced real estate professionals who specialize in specific luxury markets. Agents like Kelby Contreras at Realty ONE Group Evolution have established relationships with property owners, other agents, and local community members, often gaining access to these exclusive listings before they become public. Regularly engaging with such agents, clearly communicating your preferences, and being pre-qualified can significantly increase your chances of being notified about suitable opportunities in areas like Miami Beach, Fort Lauderdale Beach, or Key Biscayne.
